pages.title: Halloran Brassmere
pages.text: $(l)Charter Administrator. Senior. Neutral.$()$(br2)Halloran is the administrator who shows up to every tea, sits between Saskia and Yoki, and says almost nothing. He drinks one cup. He listens. He leaves before the bell.

What Halloran does is not, strictly, on record. He is an administrator. He administrates.$(br2)What is on record: every faction tea Halloran attends ends without bloodshed. Every audit Halloran witnesses ends with a signed ledger. Every Foreman who has met Halloran says the same thing afterward — $(o)"he listens."$()

Halloran is the senior Charter administrator most likely to be in the room when something difficult happens. Most senior Foremen take this as a comfort.$(br2)A few take it as a warning. Both readings have, in the Charter's history, been correct.
